content: Paisa mono kiye kina'miba yagama kurapa maema muta atantawe
Pigoya, marusa kamanapa Kotiba uwaitamagina, aeba mono ukena kipe mampara aota mono nama kikenaenabe uwaimima iyakintiye.
Piya, igeba ka seri nama asitamagini, marusa marupi kanepe yarebe Koti nkaobi atanta paretibe atauguna waintantiye. Pi mparukaba: Aota marune, omintawe.
Piya, akapintiba tabe kai itama akugasimagini aka'isa marukaba: Aota marutaka'yane, untawe.

Piya, pi mparupi kaema agunta pasa atakena korirasa punta arata atamagini, nayatara'mu kamana wainta korirasa airari kaenta pokisi kaga atantawe. Pi pokisi antabaipintiba mana naninta wainta korirasa punta kankabebe, Eroni nkasarasa asae'wa pama iraome nkasabe, nayatara'mu kamana kaema aminti ntaba tarabe, kaga atantawe.
Piya, tara enisore kina'mi nkimapa pi polisi abobori potaugunisi, e'wasa Koti antara puratakena auka'i kabintase. We, ibaba kanaenama nkagoba a'ya'maba kampa aborakuwe.
Pigoya, pabiyama atauguna waintogini, mono kiye kina'miba pi aota seri namapinti ite tumite puma marusa marupinti asu pai'ma, mono yugawaipa puntawe.

Aibuguna, monota paitanta yagara ka'wainantoba aka'isa aota marupintiba asu pasintiye. Asi nasiba kampaye. Aeba a'ya'ma kabuba ka yaga ka yaga asu pasintiye. Piya, aeba uwaba kampa inta, aeba korapa mae u'ma ae'waka muta atama a'ya'ma kina'mi nkaibo'enawaika kaga aeyoba itakena ubasintiye.
Pintanaba Aota Awamusa'ama mayama tayakintiye: Pi aota seri namapa uwa waintegina marusa auka'i mono yuga uwa pepa, Koti nkaota namapi uma pasikena kipa kampa aborantiyema, napiyiyoma tayakintiye.
Piya, ma kanarapa pi seri nama kanta puma waiye. Piya, wasanamiba paisa mono aega'ma i'muntanabe muta atakenaenabe Koti amegana, pipa napiyenawaimpaba aota'enaba kampa potaye. Kampaye.

Piya, naninta nakenaenabe wani ntakenaenabe, wani pasikenaenabe, pika paisa mono'amaba uramiye. Eya, paisaenamaba tau'ama nkagoba wairite kanama waiyegina, a'ya'maena uma arupu pukibi ntaga uma nagarikiye.
Karaisiti aeba ae'wa kuratasa muta atantiye

Piya, kasa aogiyenaba aboramogana, Karaisitiba kasa monota paitaratanti kiyeba ago ampa aborantiye. Piya, kasa monopipa ubai'ma, paisa seri mono namapa asugasaye. Piya, kasa'enaba wasanamaba kampa ayapisaba puma mampabisaenaba kampaye. Pipa inatisaenawe.
Piya, Karaisitiba aeba aota marupintiba asu pasintipa, aeba memewama kurape purumaka nkawaroma kurape kampa maete asu pasintiye. Kampaye. Aeba ae'wa kuratasa muta atama ika puratantika miyaba mikune.

Piya, wasanami i'nintana puguniba, paisa mono kiye kina'miba memewama kurape purumakankama kurape purumaka nkawaro kaenta kagupe maema, wasanami nkiti asunu kaeyuguna, asu'a puma i'amaba Koti nkaobipa aogi puntiye.

We, Karaisiti kurankama asugaintiye. Piya, Karaisitiba aibo'enaba kapa kampa punta, aota mimagina, miyaba Awamusa'ama nkesegiyenarasa ae'wa nkaupa Kotiti muta atantiye. Eya, pi ntugarasa korankamaba napiyenaretasa arirasaena asu'a puma, kasa taumaba tamegi aoganti Kotiti kayokaya'ena potaune.
Korankama aguntaenaba aeyobakasaye

Piya, Isu aeba Kotike wasanage atarawaisitakena yagara mima, kasa atokaekena kamana esegi piye. Aeba piya pumagina, taba puratai wasanamitepa waiyaba'ena utaratantintanabi ubaseno. Eya, akayuyompentanabisa ika puratakenaga Isuba purintiye.
Piya, pure kina'mi kuta eta'maima wasana imikena pepa, marupa taga pu'wayema umagini eta'maikibewe.
Eya, wasana aogama minteginiba, kotankapa kampa eta'maiyewe. Aeba pureginiba, eta'maiyewe.
Piya, marusa mono kamana pai uma esegi puntapa, igeba yaga aeguma korankapa Koti nkaobi pai'atama esegi puntawe.

Eya, maru'enaba Mosese aeba ago kamanapisa a'ya'ma Koti unti kamana a'ya'ma kina'mipa uwaimitegina, purumaka nkawaroma korape memewama korape wanipe maemagina, sipisipiwama tete aepe kakintape maema aeyu'ma, Koti nkisatibe a'ya'ma kina'mi nkitibe aeguse pugasogana wagana kana puntiye.
Aibumagina, Moseseba: Pi kurankamaba Kotiti atokaeritakena untintanaba esegi potaye, untiye.
Piya pumagina, Moseseba seri mono namatibe mono namapisa kankaberibe korapa aeguse puma pai'itantiye.
Eya, ago kamana untitaka, korankama uwomantana aeyoba'ma aogi puwaitaye. Piya, kora kampa pagemisinta, aguntaenawaipa kampa aeyobakasasine.
Karaisitiba ae'wa nkautasa muta atantiye
Pigoya, mampara monopa mantabinti waintintanama nkamankane. Piya, marasaena aota potakena puntiniba, pabiyama yaga kuratasa aeyobantawe. We, mantarasaena muta atama aota potakenaenaba to awametane.

Eya, Karaisiti aeba tagantanabi ubasintiye. Piya, wasanami serirasa kimaranta aota mono namapa aeba amankane. Pi ntamapinti wanane. Aeba mantabinti asu pai'ma, ibaba Koti nkaobi uma aborama tao'maeye.

Pigoya, paisa monota paitanta kiye kina'miba ka ka kabura yagama kurapa maerite wama Kotiti muta atakenaga aota marupintiba ubasi puntawe. Kaboga kaboga puntasa puma, Karaisitiba ae'wa kuratasaba piyaba kampa puntiye. Kampaye.

Piya, aeba kaboga kaboga puntemisinta, Koti mampa puntemi ntaga aukigakenaenawapa agobima wairite kanantesine. Pipa kampaye. Kanapa agarosaogana, Karaisitiba ka yaga ae'wa nkaupa Kotiti muta atama aguntaena maegaintiye.
Piya, a'ya'ma kina'mitaba ka'anto purukubompeka uratantikana, aintiba kamanatepa aborakiye.

Piya pogana, Karaisitiba uwaena kina'mi nkaguntaena mae igaikenaga ae'wa nkaupa ka yaga Kotiti muta atantiye. Aibuntana, aintiba to kakema tumikibipa, aguntaenaba to kakema mae igaikena wanane. Aeba aobi punta kina'mi nki'ima ibabute ikenaga tumikiye.
